name: Knightmare Tower 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Knightmare Tower is an action-packed adventure game where you embark on a daring mission to rescue kidnapped princesses from the clutches of an evil being lurking atop the tower. Armed with your trusty sword and unwavering determination, it's time to ascend the perilous tower and face whatever challenges lie in your path!
